description: This file defines the NotesAPI_1_0 interface for interacting with the Nextcloud Notes API v1. It includes method signatures for CRUD operations on notes and settings, using Retrofit annotations for HTTP requests.

classes.name: NotesAPI_1_0
classes.description: Interface defining the Nextcloud Notes API v1 endpoints using Retrofit annotations for network requests.

methods.name: getNotes
methods.description: Retrieves a list of notes modified after a specified timestamp, optionally using ETag for caching.

methods.name: getNotesIDs
methods.description: Fetches IDs and metadata of notes, excluding certain fields.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note on the server.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Fetches a specific note by its remote ID.

methods.name: editNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by remote ID.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note by remote ID.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates a note by its ID with given note data.
